variants.headline: Still in view: request for more shipping refused
variants.sub: A colonial request for additional shipping has been rejected by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has refused the colony's request for more shipping. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

A rejected increase should not be entered into a forecast as a reduction in current service. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
